name: Meguro Writer
author: kenget

sections.description:
Meguro Writer is a WordPress plugin that uses Google Gemini and Google Search grounding to discover current topics, generate original articles, create featured images, and publish on a configurable schedule.

It is designed for a wide range of media sites and can be configured for different countries, regions, languages, editorial styles, post types, taxonomies, publishing statuses, authors, image settings, and schedules.

Main features:

  • Discover current news and topics with Google Search grounding.
  • Configure custom search topics such as technology, business, finance, real estate, entertainment, politics, and local news.
  • Configure the media name, AI role, target audience, article purpose, tone, and additional instructions.
  • Select article language and search language independently.
  • Target up to 10 countries or regions at the same time.
  • Use regional groups and a global mode with priority countries or regions.
  • Target the United States nationally or by state and Washington, D.C.
  • Target China nationally or by province, municipality, or autonomous region.
  • Treat Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao as separate selectable targets in the plugin interface.
  • Adjust editorial selection with six 10-level sliders.
  • Configure excluded topics, source preferences, and additional AI prompts.
  • Choose the WordPress post type, taxonomy, publishing status, and author used for generated posts.
  • Configure a separate schedule for each day of the week, with up to 15 publishing times per day.
  • Use the Monthly Publishing Plan to override individual date/time slots with a specific topic, an original AI-written column, a skip action, or an extra one-time post.
  • Detect duplicate source URLs and similar titles.
  • Configure minimum relevance, confidence, news freshness, and article length.
  • Create scheduled original columns with a fixed title, theme, writing instructions, optional reference URLs, and category.
  • Write Yoast SEO descriptions and focus keyphrases when applicable.
  • Enable or disable summary points and source boxes.
  • Optionally embed X posts, Instagram posts/reels, and YouTube videos.
  • Optionally add verified official-site and official-social links related to the article.
  • Optionally prefer suitable official press/media images and display image-source attribution.
  • Optionally split broad topics into a linked 2-4 part article series.
  • Generate featured images with Gemini using an exact pixel size or aspect ratio.
  • Optionally use up to three reference images for image generation.
  • Use a common featured image as a fallback when image generation is unavailable.
  • Map generated data to ACF or other custom fields.
  • Optionally make older generated articles private or move them into a private, reviewable archive. Only administrators can permanently delete archived articles and unused dedicated featured images.
  • Optionally archive generated articles at or below a chosen view count after a minimum age, using a compatible view counter or numeric post meta.
  • Export and import plugin settings and the Monthly Publishing Plan as JSON.
  • View execution logs, send failure notifications, run a manual post, and test the Gemini API connection.
  • Diagnose WP-Cron, external Cron, self-loopback connectivity, and possible Cloudflare/WAF/firewall blocking without automatically changing security settings.
  • Open a dedicated Support page to optionally support development through PayPal or contact the developer by email. All plugin features remain free regardless of contributions.

Support contact: kenget0616@gmail.com

Article Cleanup and Archive Management

Article Cleanup is disabled by default. Go to Meguro Writer > Settings > Article Cleanup to enable these independent policies:

  • Make generated articles Private after a configurable number of days.
  • Move generated articles into a review archive after a configurable number of days.
  • Move generated articles into a review archive when their total view count is at or below a configurable threshold, after a minimum number of days.

Only posts explicitly marked as generated by Meguro Writer, including compatible older posts, are eligible. Ordinary posts written manually in WordPress are excluded. Already archived posts and posts opted out at the individual article level are excluded from further automatic cleanup. Articles are evaluated from their original publication dates.

Archive does not delete content or media. The plugin sets the article to Private, records a dedicated archive flag, and shows it under Meguro Writer > Archive Management. Only an administrator can choose to republish archived posts or permanently delete selected archived articles after confirming the irreversible action. Republishing marks the article as excluded from further automatic cleanup. Images remain intact while archived; permanently deleting a post may delete its dedicated thumbnail only when no known references exist elsewhere. Shared fallback images and configured reference images are preserved.

For view-based archiving, select WP-PostViews (views post meta), Post Views Counter (pvc_get_post_views), or custom numeric post meta. Missing or invalid view data never counts as zero and never causes archiving. This uses the view counter’s recorded cumulative views, not Google Analytics pageviews.

Optionally enable archive review emails when the pending archive count reaches a configurable minimum (20 by default). Choose a frequency of Daily, Weekly (default), Monthly (calendar month), or Custom (every 1-365 days). Emails summarize the pending count and link to Archive Management. When the count drops below the threshold, the notification cycle resets. Email notifications are OFF by default. A working WordPress mail transport is required.

Cleanup and notifications run through an independent daily WP-Cron event (maximum 30 article changes per run). If an external Cron or server scheduler is used, the job depends on that scheduler. The first scheduled run is approximately ten minutes after enabling the policy. WP-Cron timing is not guaranteed to be exact, especially on low-traffic sites.

Settings backup and restore

Open Meguro Writer > Settings Backup to export or import the plugin configuration in JSON format.

The backup can include general settings, publishing settings, editorial rules, language and region settings, search topics, image settings, SEO settings, social embeds, weekly schedules, the Monthly Publishing Plan, and custom-field mappings.

The Gemini API key is excluded by default. It is included only when the administrator explicitly enables API-key export.

When importing settings into another site, review user, media, post type, taxonomy, and custom-field selections because those items may differ between WordPress sites.

Support and optional contributions

Meguro Writer is fully functional and free to use. Contributions are optional and do not unlock or restrict any plugin features.

The Meguro Writer > Support page lets administrators open a PayPal.Me support link or contact the developer by email.

Supported contribution currencies are USD, JPY, and EUR. The minimum amount is JPY 1,000 or USD/EUR 10.

External services

Meguro Writer uses Google Gemini API / Google AI services for news discovery, article generation, image generation, and API connection tests.

Activating the plugin alone does not send requests to Google. Requests are made only when an administrator configures an API key and uses a connection test, manual generation, or scheduled generation.

Data that may be sent to Google includes administrator-configured search topics, prompts and editorial instructions, selected language and geographic targeting, news information used for article generation, optional reference URLs, image-generation instructions, and reference images when enabled.

Meguro Writer is not designed to collect ordinary site visitors’ personal information and send it to Gemini.

Google AI for Developers / Gemini API:
https://ai.google.dev/

Gemini API Additional Terms of Service:
https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms

Google Privacy Policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

Gemini API pricing:
https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing

If X, Instagram, or YouTube embedding is enabled and a generated article contains an embed, the visitor’s browser connects directly to the corresponding third-party service when the article is viewed. Those providers may receive technical information according to their own policies.

YouTube:
https://www.youtube.com/
YouTube Terms of Service:
https://www.youtube.com/t/terms

X:
https://x.com/
X Privacy Policy:
https://x.com/en/privacy

Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/
Meta Privacy Policy:
https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

Social embedding is optional and disabled by default for each provider.

When the official-image preference is enabled, Meguro Writer may retrieve an image from an official source selected during news discovery and store it in the WordPress Media Library. Site administrators remain responsible for confirming image rights and usage conditions.

Google may apply different data-handling terms depending on the Gemini API plan or service tier. Review the current terms and privacy policy before using the service with confidential or personal information.

The optional Support page may connect to PayPal only when an administrator explicitly opens a PayPal.Me support link. Simply opening the Meguro Writer Support page does not contact PayPal.

PayPal:
https://www.paypal.com/

PayPal Privacy Statement:
https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/paypal/privacy-full

Privacy

Meguro Writer does not include its own analytics, telemetry, or usage tracking.

When Gemini API features are used, the data described in the External services section is sent to Google for generation or search-related processing.

When social embeds are enabled and present in an article, visitors viewing that article may connect directly to YouTube, X, or Instagram. Review the relevant provider privacy policies and update your site’s privacy notice as appropriate.

If a settings backup is exported with the Gemini API key included, the resulting JSON file contains confidential credentials and must be stored securely.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, open Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the Meguro Writer ZIP file and activate the plugin.
  3. Open Meguro Writer > Settings.

  4. Get a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio: https://aistudio.google.com/

    Configure the key in Meguro Writer. It can be stored in the plugin settings, but defining it in wp-config.php is recommended:

    define(‘MEGURO_WRITER_GEMINI_API_KEY’, ‘YOUR_API_KEY’);

  5. Configure the article language, search language, target countries or regions, publishing destination, search topics, audience, editorial settings, and schedule.

  6. Run the Gemini API connection test.
  7. Use the manual single-post generation action before enabling automated publishing.
  8. If DISABLE_WP_CRON is enabled or a CDN/WAF/firewall blocks WordPress loopback requests, configure an external scheduler or server Cron and verify it from Meguro Writer > Diagnostics & Debug.
sections.faq:
Does Meguro Writer automatically create new categories?

No. The plugin selects from existing terms in the configured taxonomy. A configured fallback term can be used when no suitable existing term is returned.

Will WordPress Cron always run at the exact configured time?

WP-Cron is triggered by site traffic and may not execute at an exact time. For production sites that require predictable schedules, use a server cron job or another scheduler to call wp-cron.php regularly.

Is the Gemini API key included in configuration backups?

Not by default. It is included only when the administrator explicitly enables the API-key export option.

Can I publish international news in Japanese?

Yes. Geographic targeting and article language are independent. For example, you can target the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada while generating the final articles in Japanese.

How are Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao handled?

In the Meguro Writer targeting interface, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao are separate selectable targets and are not included in the China province/subregion selector.

Can I prioritize several countries while still searching globally?

Yes. Use Global mode and select up to 10 priority countries or regions. The regional-focus slider controls how strongly those selected targets are prioritized relative to worldwide news.

How do social embeds work?

You can enable X, Instagram, and YouTube independently and set a combined per-article maximum. Meguro Writer asks Gemini to return directly relevant official or primary-source post/video URLs. Embeds are rendered only for enabled providers. Viewing an embedded item connects the visitor’s browser to the corresponding provider.

Does the plugin automatically reuse any image it finds online?

No. The official-image preference is optional. When enabled, Gemini is instructed to return an official press/media image only when it appears suitable for attributed use. If retrieval fails, Meguro Writer falls back to AI image generation or the configured common featured image. Administrators remain responsible for checking image rights.

Manual generation works, but scheduled automatic publishing does not. What should I check?

Open Meguro Writer > Diagnostics & Debug. The screen checks whether the Meguro Writer Cron event is registered, whether Cron has reached the plugin recently, whether DISABLE_WP_CRON is enabled, and whether WordPress can make a safe loopback HTTP request to itself.

Cloudflare, WAFs, firewalls, Basic Authentication, CDNs, rate limits, SSL/DNS issues, or access policies can block loopback requests. Meguro Writer does not bypass or automatically modify those security controls. If standard WP-Cron is unreliable or blocked, use an external scheduler, Cloudflare Worker/Cron Trigger, server Cron, or WP-CLI to run WordPress Cron every 1-5 minutes. If you adjust a WAF, prefer a narrow rule for /wp-cron.php instead of disabling the WAF globally. When DISABLE_WP_CRON is true, an external Cron is required.

Does automatic publishing require an accuracy acknowledgement?

Yes. Generated articles can include factual errors or inaccuracies. In Meguro Writer > Settings, read and accept the accuracy notice before enabling automatic publishing. Adjusting prompts may improve accuracy, but cannot guarantee perfect correctness. Sites upgrading from an earlier version are marked as acknowledged automatically to preserve their existing automatic publishing setting. New installations start without acknowledgement. Manual generation remains available. A settings backup cannot transfer the acknowledgement from another site.
sections.changelog:
3.6.9

  • Added a multilingual Free Tier and Google Search grounding notice immediately below the Gemini model setting.
  • Recommend gemini-2.5-flash-lite where accessible; clarify Gemini 2.5 Flash eligibility, new-project access restrictions, and billing requirements for Google Search with Gemini 3 and newer models.
  • The notice does not change models, enable billing, or alter publishing behavior.

3.6.8

  • Added manual cleanup filters (age only, page views only, OR, AND) for generated posts, with a mandatory preview list and explicit per-article selection before archive or permanent deletion. Actions are revalidated server-side at execution time; no unpreviewed posts are affected.
  • Added opt-in article lifecycle management: automatically make older generated posts private, or move age-eligible and low-view generated posts into a private archive for administrator review. No automatic permanent deletion.
  • Added an Archive Management page to inspect, republish, and manually permanently delete selected archived articles. Republished articles are excluded from repeat cleanup.
  • Added an opt-in archive backlog notification: configurable minimum item count (20 by default), email reminder frequency (daily, weekly, monthly, or every 1-365 days; weekly by default), optional recipient, and admin dashboard notice.
  • Added selectable view counters for WP-PostViews, Post Views Counter, and custom numeric post meta; absent/invalid counter data never triggers archiving.
  • Added individual article exclusions, daily bounded Cron execution, persistent cursor, and cleanup audit logs.
  • On administrator-confirmed permanent deletion, dedicated featured images are removed only if safe and not referenced elsewhere. Shared images and references are preserved.
  • All automatic cleanup and email notifications are disabled by default. Already-published ordinary/manual WordPress articles are never eligible.

3.6.6

  • Hotfix: Ensure the required Diagnostics & Debug class is included in the WordPress.org release package.
  • No changes to publishing features or accuracy-acknowledgement behavior.

3.6.5

  • Make the AI-accuracy warning’s red border and text reliably visible on the settings screen even when admin CSS is not loaded.
  • Enforce the consent checkbox dependency directly in the settings screen when admin JavaScript is missing or stale.
  • Preserve existing auto-publishing choices, including repair of inconsistent legacy settings from the previous update.

3.6.4

  • Added a prominent red-bordered AI accuracy notice and an explicit acknowledgement checkbox above the Automatic Publishing setting.
  • Automatic publishing cannot be newly enabled without acknowledgement; validation is enforced in the admin UI and on the server.
  • Existing installations are migrated as acknowledged, preserving their saved automatic-publishing ON/OFF state; new installations start unchecked.
  • Settings backups cannot transfer an accuracy acknowledgement from a different site.
  • Translated the new admin text into all 10 supported languages.

3.6.3

  • Expanded Diagnostics & Debug with safe self-loopback testing and Cron activity health checks.
  • Added external-Cron-aware status so DISABLE_WP_CRON=true is treated as healthy when recent external Cron arrivals are detected.
  • Added Cloudflare/Sucuri detection when identifiable from response headers and classified common WAF, firewall, authentication, rate-limit, timeout, SSL, DNS, and connection failures.
  • Added environment-specific recovery guidance for external HTTP Cron, server Cron/WP-CLI, and narrowly scoped WAF exceptions without automatically changing security settings.
  • Added setup guidance and FAQ documentation for Cloudflare/WAF/firewall environments.

3.6.2

  • Added a Diagnostics & Debug screen for WP-Cron registration, next-run time, last Cron heartbeat, today’s publishing slots, environment information, and recent debug events.
  • Added an optional Debug Mode that stores detailed Cron and article-generation events for up to 7 days / 500 entries while masking API keys and other secrets.
  • Added one-click Cron re-registration and a manual diagnostic probe including Gemini API connectivity.
  • Improved Cron self-healing so a missing Meguro Writer schedule is automatically recreated when the plugin loads.
  • Added diagnostic visibility for publishing slots that missed the existing 29-minute execution window.
  • Added the new diagnostics UI translations and updated PO source catalogs for all 10 supported admin languages.

3.6.1

  • Changed newly generated X embeds to the official blockquote.twitter-tweet + platform.x.com/widgets.js card format instead of the direct Tweet iframe.
  • Kept backward compatibility for previously generated social embed shortcodes; existing X embeds now render through the same official X widget format.
  • Added a safe link fallback when the X widget script cannot render a post, preventing the previous large empty iframe area.
  • Shortened the WordPress.org Short Description to stay within the 150-character limit.

3.6.0

  • Added a direct Google AI Studio link beside the Gemini API key setting.
  • Added a collapsed API credit and cost guide with current examples for text generation, Google Search grounding, and image generation, plus a link to Google’s official pricing page.
  • Added translations for the new API guidance across all 10 supported admin UI languages.
  • Added PO source catalogs for all 10 supported admin UI languages.
  • Simplified the public readme by removing obsolete migration and internal implementation details that are not relevant to normal users.

3.5.3

  • Moved extra one-time posts from the monthly summary block to the corresponding calendar date row.
  • Added a per-day extra-post count badge so dates with extra posts are immediately identifiable.
  • Extra posts are collapsed by default and can be expanded or collapsed under each date.

3.5.2

  • Added image output settings for exact pixel size or aspect ratio.
  • Featured images are resized or cropped to the configured dimensions before logo overlay.
  • Improved the live show/hide behavior of logo and tone settings.
  • Added a direct link to the Support page from the Backup / Support panel.

3.5.1

  • Removed outdated product-name wording from the visible admin UI.
  • Improved compatibility while keeping the user-facing interface focused on Meguro Writer.

3.5.0

  • Added logo overlay settings, tone and manner settings, prohibited-word controls, Japanese writing-style selection, and optional title-length limits.

3.4.5

  • Improved the PayPal.Me support controls and minimum-amount validation.

3.4.0

  • Added the Column publishing method to the Monthly Publishing Plan with titles, themes, instructions, reference URLs, and categories.

3.3.0

  • Added automatic admin-language detection and built-in support for 10 admin UI languages.

3.2.0

  • Added social embeds, official links, official-image preference, image attribution, and optional linked article series.

3.1.0

  • Added independent article and search languages, multi-region targeting, regional groups, global mode, and detailed United States/China targeting.
